title: Cycle C2: embed multi-screen/regions editor in Display LAYOUT
description:
C1 dropped the dashboardScreens multi-screen/regions editor from the Display LAYOUT section (spec §4 wanted it 'embedded as-is'; the C1 plan omitted it). Region-to-component assignment is currently UNREACHABLE from the new Settings shell, though the rail subtitle says 'regions'. The editor lives in frontend/src/components/settings/tabs/dashboard/DashboardLayoutTab.vue (it also has orientation controls now duplicated by DisplaySettings rows).

## Context
Cycle C1 final-review IMPORTANT-2. Spec §10.
design: Extract the screen-stack/region picker out of DashboardLayoutTab into its own component; embed it in DisplaySettings LAYOUT as a SettingsSection without duplicating orientation rows. Update registry/search anchors.

title: Cycle C2: migrate remaining Settings categories to the new shell
description:
Cycle C1 (PR #60, branch feat/design-settings-cycle-c) built the new Settings shell (CategoryRail focus-light, SettingsSearch, breadcrumbs, SettingsSection/SettingRow eyebrow rows, NumberStepper/ThemePicker/TypefacePicker) and migrated only the Display category (DisplaySettings.vue). The other five rail entries still render their OLD components inside the new shell: ClockBarCategory, ContentSourcesCategory, PluginsCategory, DeviceCategory, MaintenanceCategory (+ their tabs under components/settings/tabs/).

## Context
Touch/visual redesign. Spec docs/design/2026-06-28-cycle-c-settings.md §1,§10. Cycles A(#58)/B(#59)/C1(#60) done.
design: For each category, replace the old TabNavigation+tabs with eyebrow SettingsSection(s) of SettingRow using the C1 shell controls (SegmentedControl/ToggleSwitch/SelectPill/NumberStepper). Preserve useConfigForm auto-save + each setting's config key; update settingsRegistry search destinations (former tabs -> section anchors per category) like DisplaySettings. PluginsCategory COLLIDES with the parked plugin-repository WIP (branch wip/plugin-repository) — reconcile when that lands. Plugin instance forms (PluginFieldRenderer/instance_config_schema) stay intact, restyle field primitives only.

title: Add calendar fullscreen mode (touch ⤢)
description:
Cycle B removed the calendar region's touch ⤢ control because it mapped to 'open the marked event', unintuitive on touch (you tap the event directly). The intended touch behaviour for ⤢ is to fullscreen the calendar, but no calendar-fullscreen mode exists (only photos and web_services have fullscreen via modeStore.enterFullscreen).

## Context
Cycle B dashboard redesign, PR #59. Spec: docs/design/2026-06-28-cycle-b-dashboard.md
design: Add a calendar fullscreen path analogous to photos/web_services (maximize calendar to fill the stage; reuse the Cycle B fullscreen ✕ touch-close; keyboard exit). Re-add ⤢ to MAP.calendar.expand in frontend/src/components/dashboard/RegionControls.vue wired to the new action. Keep keyboard 'calendar_expand' (open event) unchanged.

title: Restyle the embedded Settings editors into the new shell vocabulary
description: Cycle C2 migrates Clock bar / Device / Maintenance to the new shell but EMBEDS specialized editors as-is (legacy tokens / old blue accent kept; restyle deferred). Final embed set after the C2 design: (1) ClockBarFontSizePicker — clock-bar sizing, horizontal + vertical-with-preview; (2) ClockBarItemsTab — clock-bar status-tile editor; (3) DisplayScheduleGrid — per-day display-power schedule grid, lift-and-shifted out of PowerTab in C2; (4) KeyboardTab — Device keyboard remapping UI; (5) UpdatesTab — embedded WHOLE for Maintenance UPDATES (git url/branch + update trigger + status + backend-health), since those are tightly coupled. Related: calvin-4k8 (regions editor, same embed-as-is pattern in Display LAYOUT).
design: Convert each embedded editor to the new SettingRow/SettingsSection + shell-control vocabulary and new semantic tokens (--ink/--bg-*/--focus/--line/--ok/--warn/--err), removing legacy tokens (--accent-primary/--text-*/--bg-secondary/--border-color) and hardcoded hex. For UpdatesTab consider splitting git config (simple text rows) from the status/health block. Keyboard vocabulary stays frozen (KeyboardTab UI may change; the action set may not).

title: C1 polish follow-ups: weekendDays row, SelectPill aria-label, typeface at boot
description:
Small follow-ups deferred from Cycle C1 (spec §10): (1) Weekend days multi-select row in Display CALENDAR (config key weekendDays, array of 0-6) — needs a multi-toggle/chip control. (2) SelectPill has no ariaLabel prop, so DisplaySettings enum pills aren't directly labelled for screen readers — add an ariaLabel prop to components/ui/SelectPill.vue and pass row labels from DisplaySettings. (3) The saved type theme is only applied when opening Settings (TypefacePicker calls loadTypeTheme on mount); call useTypeTheme().loadTypeTheme() once at app init (frontend/src/main.js or root) so the persisted typeface is active on the dashboard at boot.

## Context
Cycle C1 deferrals. Spec docs/design/2026-06-28-cycle-c-settings.md §10.
